title: ArcCivs181-199 navigation territory maintenance and exact-slot control relocation
assumptions: Runtime0.1.180 is the baseline.0.1.181 changes navigation, natural vegetation maintenance and physical control placement; production rates, recipe quantities, reward chances and paid accepted jobs are unchanged.

Participants1/7/16 settlements and maintenance events1/100/10000 per settlement-day are sensitivity inputs, not measured throughput. Every direct currency and player XP amount is zero before and after.

Vegetation writes AIR with physics=false and has no drop, item, XP, Stock or inventory issuance. Productive forester groves and already accepted forestry jobs stay protected; removal consumes finite existing natural world trees without creating saleable items.

Control relocation moves exact existing native slots and NBT from one27-slot barrel to another; no resource reward, item refund or inventory rewrite is allowed. Per-item conservation is checked by native receipt tests, not an invented exchange rate.

Bulk chunk snapshots and faster routing can increase completed legitimate work per hour. The scale is unmeasured before delivery; per-action yields, debits, resident skill and existing supply caps are unchanged. Native comparable route and paid-commit observations are required separately.

Existing-gate maintenance issues no items or resources. Future generated flat-gate material sinks are assessed separately in gate-refit-economy-20261101.json; stepped existing gates retain their exact native floor.

No combined currency unit or item SELL quote is used. Active SELL/AutoSell and planned SELL-to-contract remain separate; no downstream sales, savings or new earning potential are inferred from zero direct money mint.

185 aligns detached flat WALK admission with unchanged native crossed-support checks. An exact891-cell stair capture previously produced first-frame path-changed with zero motion; the corrected local replay arrives in10ticks. This is a local geometry regression, not a measured full live trip or earning multiplier. All direct currency, item, Stock, XP and per-action quantities remain unchanged.

186 places new furniture on a dry authored bottom slab by completing only the matching slab directly beneath the barrel to a double slab through the existing durable pendingControls receipt. Before: a half-height finite world slab and an exterior control. After: one matching full-height finite support and an interior control; adjacent half-height walking surfaces remain unchanged. This adds one finite half-slab of world geometry per such relocation, with zero item drops, issued items, inventory/Stock/Vault/token/player-XP changes. Exact existing cargo slots and NBT still move through the same receipt; no earning or SELL conversion is inferred.

187 retains a legal current control before prioritizing full-support new spares. An already accepted queued upgrade defers new control relocation until the queued design is activated or retired; durable existing relocation recovery still completes. Typed upgrade registration retirement removes only exact changing owned source registrations after native empty-slot evacuation is durable, including a strictly proved initially empty source. All pre-existing item slots and NBT are conserved; a late native refill/state/permission mismatch refuses registry publication. Removed empty physical holders are changed only by the ordinary paid upgrade. Registration count/capacity is not a money unit or an issued resource; no before/after production or SELL multiplier is claimed. Wall infill now waits for an unaccepted same-city search to retire before ordinary admission; the native complete bill stays26STONE_BRICKS+2DARK_OAK_FENCE, with0 direct Vault/tokens/XP or free materials.

188 aligns cargo pickup eligibility with the existing accepted upkeep input request for an ACTIVE builder hut when no paid construction order is active. Before: the trusted dispatcher can reserve16existingCOBBLESTONE but pickup rejects stale-delivery; after: the same bounded request transfers those existing items source→carrier→target through unchanged exact receipts. Source+carrier+target item amounts/NBT remain conserved; the existing input cap, stock capacity, per-action outputs, prices, rewards and currency rules do not change. Completed legitimate upkeep per hour may increase; no income multiplier is measured. An explicit validated wall SITE can append to the ordinary FIFO while selected road work is pending; actual queue activation retains road-maintenance priority. Full native bill remains26STONE_BRICKS+2DARK_OAK_FENCE, with no free paste, resources, work credit, Vault, tokens or XP.

189 treats world-busy construction scanner admission as a transient five-second retry of the same accepted row and gives a persisted legacy world-busy pause one guarded retry after normal access/chunk checks. Before: an ordinary finite admission rejection can strand the paid order indefinitely. After: existing work, bill, reserved payment, per-row debit and native placement checks remain unchanged; no work credit, item or currency is issued. Workshop allocation now consults the same captured production-output headroom used by the native commit instead of ordinary input/cargo capacity. Before: reserve-only slots can cause repeated impossible craft attempts. After: the same pending recipe waits for usable room and recovers when it exists, preserving carried inputs and native receipts. Per-action output amounts, two-slot headroom, prices, resource reserves and all currency rules remain unchanged. Direct before/after Vault, tokens and player XP remain separately zero. Restored legitimate progress is not a measured production or SELL multiplier.

189 carried-meal sessions preserve the exact observed fractional feet on paths, slabs and stairs and validate native support/body/fire before cancelling an existing work route. The same location witness is rechecked before the ordinary delayed meal receipt. Before: integer rounding can refuse the session after cancelling navigation every five seconds. After: accepted eating consumes the same food once; walking, denied sessions, unsupported/moved/obstructed late sessions earn no meal, health, skill, work credit or resource. No food batch, nutrition, consumption duration, currency or earning rate changes. Tavern authored approach/seat handling remains on its existing branch.

189 road infrastructure only uses an optional raw-route downhill hint when the same column and height still exist in the final permitted paving floors. Before: a protected omitted or accepted regraded neighboring column can violate the strict pavement precondition and abort the whole infrastructure request. After: an inconsistent hint uses the existing actual-neighbor/fallback pavement choice; protected/occupied columns remain excluded, accepted paid infrastructure is unchanged, strict pathPavement contracts remain intact. No resource bill, item issuance, work credit, currency, XP, foundation allowance or production parameter changes. Direct before/after amounts remain separately zero in all assessed units.

190 permits the ordinary producer output-return route before a full64-unit stack only when the current accepted construction is WAITING_MATERIALS and the producer already has enough exportable excess of that exact awaited material to cover min(current-row total requirement,64). Before: V4 has71carriedCOBBLESTONE,32reserve and39exportable, while its accepted row awaits12 and its quarry barrel holds exactly32reserve; waiting for64exportable can strand the build despite existing usable material. After: the same existing excess can return through the ordinary own-barrel receipt and courier pipeline. This is a finite transfer of existing items, not production, a grant or an advance of work. The32producer reserve,64maximum shipment, per-action yields/debits, accepted row cost, item metadata and exact pickup/dropoff receipts remain unchanged. No-await, other-material and insufficient-excess cases retain normal batching. Direct before/after Vault, tokens and player XP are separately zero; delivery latency can improve, while actual hourly throughput and downstream SELL remain unmeasured.

191 performance repair keeps the exact citizen-control collision predicate for nearby or touching controls and rejects only strictly disjoint expanded boxes before allocation/ray tracing. Terrain route-local primitive maps/sets and unboxed priority comparators preserve packed coordinate encoding, signed key and score/ordinal ordering, costs, budgets, no-repeat columns, height/permission constraints and the selected route. No world state, production timer, yield, recipe, food, resource reserve, paid construction, work credit, item receipt or currency rule changes. Direct before/after Vault, tokens and player XP remain separately zero. Lower CPU/allocation is tested separately with matched JFR and host observations; any restored legitimate throughput or downstream SELL effect is unmeasured and is not treated as free production or an income multiplier.

192 preserves complete route-node identity but replaces collision-prone linear hashing with mixed full-integer component hashing. Snapshot neighbourhoods keep the exact ordered63-cell Map contract through immutable arrays, reuse unchanged/resolved-cost blocks across overlapping probes, and cache merged palettes for the same immutable chunk/section range. Old published captures retain their own resolved costs when later batches learn a new cost. Arrival, support/body geometry, dirty revisions, native acquisition, route ordering/budget/no-repeat rules, payment and item receipts remain unchanged. No timer, yield, recipe, food or reserve value changes; before/after direct amounts are separately zero Vault, zero tokens and zero player XP. Restored legitimate throughput and current SELL effects remain unmeasured; planned SELL-to-contract is unchanged. CPU/allocation results require separate matched native profiling.

193 replaces repeated full searches with a bounded shared route cache and near-start suffix joining, revalidates current terrain/policy on replay, treats resident contacts as short local yield followed by existing body pass, tracks actually consumed snapshot sections, shares detached terrain preparation per planning input, and suppresses unchanged no-site/no-path searches for at most five minutes with local terrain/layout/goal change wake-up. Permanent native tickets cover the developed travel envelope; exact surveys acquire bounded temporary demands. Accepted journeys still require real movement, native support and unoccupied arrival. Existing construction/cargo/meal payment, exact item/NBT receipts, output quantities, recipes, food, reserves and work timers remain unchanged; no arrival, work or resources are granted by a cache hit or chunk readiness. Direct before/after amounts remain separately zero Vault, zero tokens and zero player XP. Restored legitimate throughput and downstream SELL effects require native observation and are not an earning multiplier. Planned SELL-to-contract remains unchanged.

194 memoizes unchanged failed planning separately by goal and recovery candidate before infrastructure fallback, and reuses static horizontal blockage decisions across candidate heights. Current route constraints, costs, priority ordering, support checks, resource recipes and payments are unchanged. Only demonstrably obstructed interior building columns are excluded from terrain wake; goal footprints, entrances and boundary context still wake. Recovery advances to a distinct candidate after ordinary thirty-second retry rather than waiting five minutes on an already proved invalid slot. Direct before/after Vault, tokens and player XP remain separately zero; restored legitimate throughput and downstream SELL are unmeasured. Owner separately authorized deleting all Spawn ArcCivs state and its test world and creating one isolated Lab village using existing founding rules. This reset destroys finite existing test-world items; it is not a recurring earning or free production mechanism. Lab uses isolated SQL/Redis and has no production economy bridge. Planned SELL-to-contract remains unchanged.

195 removes the speculative full34-slot future layout proof from native village founding and uses the existing single-goal placement search for planless ordinary development. Before: a new settlement cannot be founded until every future route is fully forecast, consuming sustained CPU with no residents. After: the current hall still passes foundation/native/admission checks; SITE, exact one-time96OAK_LOG+96COBBLESTONE+24BREAD grant, repeat-ID zero-grant rule, owner permissions, paid accepted work, recipe/output amounts and actual construction/cargo receipts remain unchanged. A supplied existing plan still receives its full validation and retained-plan extension semantics remain. A later building may have an ordinary local no-site/backoff instead of an upfront guarantee for all34buildings. This changes planning latency and may restore legitimate development throughput; no earning multiplier or downstream SELL value is measured. Direct before/after amounts remain separately zero Vault, zero tokens and zero player XP. Lab is isolated; current SELL and planned SELL-to-contract remain separate and unchanged.

Live195 clarification: existing Auto-settlement supply top-ups run through CivsAutoSupplies and exact native slot journals independently of the optional autoConstructionMaterials setting. In Lab, nine autonomous_supplies_granted events and eight resident pickup results were observed before18:32:07Z, including a462-item pickup at18:28:31Z; no player joins/commands or operator item injection supplied that bill. The96OAK_LOG+96COBBLESTONE+24BREAD initial grant is not the complete lifetime item-emission model. Auto top-ups of remaining construction/food inputs already existed before195 and are not changed here. These finite observations are not a hourly/weekly earning-rate estimate. Lab has no production economy bridge; actual item issuance, exact construction debits and separate current SELL versus future contracts must remain explicit.

196 reuses up to four recent successfully validated committed placement plans within the existing storage IO lock, avoiding repeated full-file reads and JSON decoding for ordinary work. Save/delete evict before their IO attempt and cache only successful committed validated readback; explicit reload clears the cache. Current native captures, permissions, accepted plan contents, item/grant/debit/food journals, production recipes, timing and quantities remain unchanged. Direct before/after amounts remain separately zero Vault, zero premium tokens and zero player XP. Existing Auto top-up inputs/caps and initial grant remain unchanged; any restored legitimate throughput or changed downstream item issuance per hour is unmeasured, not a monetary multiplier.

197 materializes static protected-building bounds once per immutable vegetation capture and the XZ subset once per column, then uses indexed Y membership instead of restarting protected-building sequences at every height. The exact candidate/phase/planned bounds and fresh apply-time before-image/permission/forester/inventory guards remain unchanged. Cleanup still produces no drops, inventory, Stock, work credit or currency and consumes only the same finite existing unprotected natural vegetation. No cadence, staleness, recipe, output, supply, construction bill, food or receipt rule changes. Direct before/after amounts remain separately zero Vault, zero tokens and zero player XP. Current SELL and future contracts remain separate, and Lab remains isolated; CPU/allocation observations are not an income multiplier.

198 computes retained paid-pavement exemptions lazily inside one road capture only when ordinary floor/cover admission requires them. The same exact original exemption map remains the fallback; actual fresh native checks, road receipts, construction payments, production intervals and Auto supply top-ups are unchanged. Direct deltas separately0Vault,0tokens,0playerXP; no item grant/refund or earning multiplier is introduced. TotalCPU and realprogress are measured on isolatedLab.

199 clears the existing native night-shelter state before admitting ordinary daytime meal or supply work. Previously a carried meal could be recreated and cancelled forever because the same actor still counted as sheltering; after the transition the unchanged lifeActorReady and native food receipt gates can complete it. Existing food quantity, nutrition, durations, hunger, production yields, Auto supply rules and receipts stay unchanged; no free meal or work credit is granted. Direct before/after amounts remain separately zero Vault, zero premium tokens and zero player XP. Restored forester throughput is not a measured earning multiplier; active SELL and planned contracts remain separate.

199 also validates one road-floor membership with an exact single-pass predicate instead of materializing the full three-wide profile map. Nearest-point priority, lower-height tie break, ordinary integer arithmetic and the final floor equality stay identical. All other profile callers, native writes, resource debits, permissions and receipts are unchanged; this computation adds no item or currency flow.
